agency: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC), Access and Eligibility Services
agency_short: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
admin_note: State-administered; eligibility determined by Texas Works Advisors in HHSC offices statewide. Policy lives in the Texas Works Handbook (TWH) with rules in 1 TAC Chapter 372; changes issue via policy bulletins and TIERS releases — and the ONLINE handbook can lag the bulletins (verified stale on ABAWD age bands in Aug 2026), so bulletins/TIERS control when they conflict.

portal.name: YourTexasBenefits.com (+ Your Texas Benefits mobile app)

verification.method: 5-cluster source fetch (browser-header strategy for the bot-blocking host; local HHSC FOIA documents) → independent cross-check → draft → eval (14 cases) → adversarial refute gate.
verification.gates: Cross-check: SAFE_TO_BUILD, 6 confirmed / 1 contradicted (the brief's wrong $22,000 vehicle figure — pack carries the correct $22,500). Refute gate: 72 claims — 61 confirmed, 11 corrected, 0 fabricated.
sources: HHSC MEPD & TW Bulletins 25-16 / 26-08 (FOIA production A05292026.0450037)
